source: User supplied report from Poco X7 Pro, 2026-10-12 19:46 America/Monterrey; not generated by the agent.

scopes.cpu: utime+stime of this process, all threads; 100% one-core equals one fully busy logical core. Total-capacity denominator is logical_cores, not other apps or frequency weighting.
scopes.frame_pacing: Recent process-frame wall intervals, includes scheduling/vsync, not CPU execution time.
scopes.gpu_lie: Last measured LIE compute timestamp interval, not GPU utilization; cached frames do not reconstruct.
scopes.gpu_memory: Vulkan RD allocator and requested LIE buffers/images; can share system RAM. Do not add to RSS.
scopes.rss: Approximate resident process pages; includes shared pages, not Android PSS or private-only RAM.
scopes.unsupported: -1 or null means unavailable / waiting, never zero load.
